        index += m

def find_k_and_arrays(n, m, w):

        k = w[0][0] + 1
        a = [0]
        b = [w[0][0]]
        return True, k, a, b
    
    # Check if all elements in the first row are distinct
    first_row = w[0]
    if len(set(first_row)) != m:
        return False, None, None, None

    k = max(max(row) for row in w) + 1
    
    # Calculate a
    a = [first_col[i] % k for i in range(n)]
    
    # Calculate b
    b = [first_row[j] % k for j in range(m)]
    
    # Verify the matrix
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(m):
            if (a[i] + b[j]) % k != w[i][j]:
                return False, None, None, None
